description: the exact B-spline twin of box [0,0,0]–[40,30,10] (Open CASCADE's STEP of primitive/box converted by occt_step.py --nurbs, every face a rational Bézier patch) minus an analytic cylinder r 4 at (20,15) from z −1 to 11: boolean/through-hole with the plate's faces NURBS, so the top and bottom meet the drill where NURBS meets cylinder (plans/nurbs-analytic-section step 7). Genus 1

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE splits the circle each bore makes on a NURBS plane in two, one more vertex and one more edge on each rim; Arris keeps each rim one edge with its one vertex, as the analytic plate has it (the same count as boolean/through-hole)
